name: Hotel Du Louvre In The Unbound Collection
description:
Hôtel du Louvre is a Hyatt Unbound Collection property in central Paris, set near the Musée du Louvre, the Comédie-Française, the Palais Garnier, and Palais Royal.
The hotel has 164 rooms including 43 suites, room service, eight meeting rooms accommodating up to 150 guests, and Clefs d'Or concierge service.
Dining centres on a Parisian brasserie with a terrace overlooking the Louvre, serving traditional French gastronomy revisited by the resident chef and pastry chef.

images.description: A wide shot captures the grand exterior of the Hotel du Louvre, a classical stone building with a distinctive mansard roof and multiple levels of windows and balconies. It stands prominently in a spacious, empty city square under a bright blue sky with wispy clouds. Other historic buildings flank the hotel, contributing to a sophisticated urban setting.

A luxurious bar area is depicted, featuring a long, dark counter lined with several plush red bar stools. Behind the counter, shelves filled with various bottles of spirits are illuminated, framed by lush green foliage cascading from above. The bar is adorned with decorative elements including stacks of antique-looking books, an old press, and potted plants, contributing to a sophisticated and inviting atmosphere.

A luxurious bar and lounge area is depicted, featuring a bartender actively preparing a drink behind a gleaming gold bar. The bar is adorned with red velvet stools and backed by shelves stocked with various bottles, framed by lush green and yellow foliage. Plush, tufted cream-colored armchairs and a small round table are arranged in the foreground on a patterned rug, creating an inviting seating area. The space is brightly lit, with natural light filtering through a decorative glass ceiling.

The image captures a grand and elegant hotel lobby featuring high ceilings, classical columns, and polished marble flooring. A modern reception desk, staffed by two individuals, is visible, with a dark wood revolving entrance door to its left. Above, a mezzanine level with seating areas and decorative lighting overlooks the main lobby. Ornate railings and a large potted palm tree contribute to the sophisticated atmosphere.

An inviting outdoor restaurant terrace is shown, featuring numerous tables meticulously set with white linens, glassware, and pepper grinders. Each table is accompanied by vibrant red cushioned chairs, arranged neatly under a series of striped awnings. The setting appears to be under a grand architectural arcade, with classical stone buildings and ornate street lamps visible in the background, suggesting a sophisticated urban environment.

Two people, seen from behind and the side, are enjoying a luxurious picnic on a red and white checkered blanket. They are surrounded by an array of gourmet food, including charcuterie, cheeses, and fresh fruit, along with drinks, all arranged around an open wicker picnic basket. The setting is a sun-dappled outdoor garden with manicured hedges, featuring a grand classical building with arched windows in the background. The image evokes a serene and elegant al fresco dining experience.

A spacious luxury hotel suite is depicted, featuring a large bed in the foreground and a distinct living area. The living area includes a blue L-shaped sofa, a round table, an armchair, and a desk with a chair. Large windows with light curtains offer a view of an ornate building facade outside. The room is elegantly decorated with patterned wallpaper and a complementary carpet.
